notes.title: WE ONLY COME OUT AT NIGHT!
notes.content:
Hell-oooo Lovelies! 

Jakob got the brilliant idea of increasing the crime level in #Archery, so we have added the Thief level and you get to try the very first version in this update. They only come out at night, cause the daylight is much to bright!

We have also reworked the graphics for Target Practice and made it day time. 

Tweaked haptic feedback/vibration in Paper Delivery. Let us know how it feels for YOU and whether you aim better with this tweak!

Other minor fixes, tablet reworked and overall clean-up.

TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!

#Tease: guess what the empty space on the tablet will be used for!?

Julie/@VRUnicorns

notes.title: 1st #Archery Update
notes.content:
Lovelies, as promised - here's the 1st #Archery Update:

First off - you've told us that Toy Factory was too easy, so Jakob added an extra assembly line under the roof: https://twitter.com/VRUnicorns/status/849033694283276288

And then he also made a florist game for anyone who fancy some nice garden work/has green fingers (as we say in Danish). Here's a hint to where you can find the florist mini-game: https://twitter.com/VRUnicorns/status/849033061731848194

I've personally taken it upon myself to add a bit of action to the Target Practice level, so let me know of any ideas you might have. I would personally fancy more aeroplanes and I enjoy shooting them down from the sky.  

Julie/@VRUnicorns
